snippet.title: Stock Market - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Stock Market
1983 - ASP Software Ltd (UK)
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Strategy Game: Management

Recorded by Jim Waterman (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/4907/ZX-Spectrum/Stock_Market

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
